onboarding.title: Private messaging
onboarding.subtitle: End-to-end encrypted. No phone number. Minimal, temporary metadata.

conversationList.selfConversationError: You can't start a conversation with yourself.
conversationList.untrustedIdentityError: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since last time (they probably reinstalled the app). Confirm the other person's identity before trying again.
conversationList.blockedChannelError: This conversation can't be started — one of you has blocked the other.
conversationList.emptyState: No conversations yet. Enter someone's user_id above to start — messages here are end-to-end encrypted.
conversationList.renameHint: Only you see this name — it stays on this phone and is never sent to the server.
conversationList.deleteConversationBody: You leave the conversation and delete its history from this phone. The other person can no longer message you here. This is not the same as blocking — either of you can start a new conversation later.
conversationList.deleteConversationFailed: Could not leave the conversation. Please try again.

conversation.emptyState: No messages in this conversation yet.
conversation.blockConfirmMessage: You won't be able to exchange messages with {{peerId}} anymore. You can unblock them later in Settings > Blocked.
conversation.securityWarningDecrypt: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since your last conversation. This message wasn't decrypted — confirm with the other person before continuing.
conversation.securityWarningSend: {{peerId}}'s security key changed since your last conversation. The message wasn't sent — confirm with the other person before continuing.
conversation.reportEmailBody:
I want to report the user with user_id: {{peerId}}

Describe what happened here (you can paste the message text in question):
conversation.deleteMessageBody: The message is deleted from the server and from this phone. If the other person has the app open it disappears from theirs too — but if they are offline, their copy may remain. Nothing prevents a screenshot.
conversation.deleteFailed: Could not delete the message from the server. It was removed from this phone.
conversation.sendFailed: Could not send. Check your connection and try again — your text is still here.
conversation.blockFailed: Couldn't block. Check your connection and try again.
conversation.editingHint: The other person will see it was edited.
conversation.editFailed: The edit didn't reach the other person. Try again.
conversation.reactionFailed: The reaction didn't reach the other person.
conversation.microphoneDenied: Seixo needs microphone access to record.
conversation.groupOwnerNote: Only whoever created the group can add or remove people.
conversation.groupNoHistoryNote: Anyone joining now cannot see earlier messages — they were encrypted with keys that person does not have.
conversation.emptyGroupNotice: This group has nobody in it yet. Tap Members to add people — messages can only be sent after that.
conversation.deleteGroupBody: The group and its messages disappear from the server for everyone. Messages each person already received stay on their phone until their timer removes them — this cannot reach those.
conversation.groupNameFailed: The name didn't reach the other members.
conversation.oneOffTtlHint: Applies to the next message only. The conversation keeps its own timer.

settings.deleteConfirmMessage: This deletes your identity and all associated data on the server (keys, prekeys, started conversations, blocks) and on this device. This can't be undone.
settings.appLockLabel: Require Face ID to open the app
settings.appLockHint: When on, Seixo asks for Face ID (or your device passcode) every time you come back to it. Messages still arrive while it's locked.
settings.appLockUnavailable: This device has no Face ID, Touch ID or passcode set, so there is nothing for Seixo to check against.

screenshotWarning.title: Screenshot
screenshotWarning.message: You took a screenshot. Remember conversations here are private — avoid sharing them.

scanQr.hint: Point the camera at the other person's QR code.
scanQr.permissionDenied: Camera access is needed to scan QR codes.

appLock.lockedBody: Use Face ID or your device passcode to open your conversations.
appLock.failedBody: Couldn't confirm it's you. Try again.

notifications.title: Seixo
notifications.groupBody: You were added to a group.

safetyNumber.title: Safety number
safetyNumber.explanation: Compare this code with the other person — in person, by call, or any way other than this app. If it matches on both phones, nobody is in the middle reading you.
safetyNumber.resetWarning: This person's security key changed. That happens when they reinstall the app — but it is also what you would see if someone were impersonating them. Only continue if you have confirmed the code above with them by other means.
